Rockstadt Fest 2027

Rockstadt Fest, Ghimbav (Brașov)

26-30 iulie '27

A new name. The same heartbeat.

For more than a decade, you've helped build something far bigger than a festival. What started as Rockstadt Extreme Fest has grown into a community recognized far beyond Romania, and today it takes the next natural step. Starting with the 2027 edition, we become Rockstadt Festival. The stages, the crowds, the atmosphere, the feeling of coming home every summer, none of that changes. This is simply the name that carries us into the next chapter.

First confirmed names: Slash featuring Myles Kennedy and The Conspirators, Overkill, Mgla, Venom, Jinjer, Towards the Sinister

One community. One heart. One new chapter.
See you at Rockstadt Festival!
